name: Glasses Finder
short_description: Find glasses by fit, prescription, frame measurements, style, and budget.
long_description: Glasses Finder ranks physical eyeglass frames by shopper fit across current frame measurements such as 52-18-140, face shape, frame width, prescription type, progressive-lens support, material, style, lens preferences, and budget. Results separate known product facts from fit inferences and missing data, explain tradeoffs, and include affiliate disclosure before outbound shopping links.
example_prompts: I wear 53-18-145. Find progressive glasses under $200.
Find lightweight frames for a narrow square face.
affiliate_disclosure: Glasses Finder may earn a commission when users buy through partner links. Recommendations rank user fit first.
review_notes: The published deployment exposes only recommend_glasses. Staging uses a curated catalog; affiliate tracking is enabled only after merchant approval. The app does not invent unavailable product dimensions, prices, colors, stock, reviews, or lens compatibility; results separate known facts, inferences, and missing data.
